facts.fact: FAO says its EOSTAT system helps Zimbabwe generate crop and yield estimates from satellite data with over 80 percent accuracy and tracks droughts and floods in real time, and a Ministry early warning specialist describes it as modernising agricultural monitoring.

systems.owner: FAO with the Ministry of Agriculture; Zimbabwe Space Agency and NUST trained

ZWE.note: Geospatial training of specialists at the Space Agency and a university is not a civil-service digital-skills programme.

facts.fact: FAO says more than 5,000 farmers, most of them women, have benefited from digital literacy and service access through its Digital Villages initiative, run with support from the Government of Zimbabwe.

systems.owner: FAO with the Government of Zimbabwe
